description_en: You can call this operation to add an endpoint
kebab_example: aliyun pvtz add-resolver-endpoint --name endpoint-test-name --vpc-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpc-id vpc-0jl96awrjt75ezglc0000 --security-group-id sg-0jld3m9yq7l2cw120000 --ip-config VSwitchId=vsw-0jlgeyq4oazkh5xue0000 Ip=172.16.XX.XX CidrBlock=172.16.XX.XX/24 AzId=cn-hangzhou-a --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddResolverEndpoint

parameters.help_en: The name of the endpoint. The name can be up to 20 characters long. An error is reported if the limit is exceeded
parameters.help_zh: 终端节点名称，最长20个字符，超过限制会报错
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the outbound VPC
parameters.name: vpc_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the outbound virtual private cloud (VPC). All outbound DNS query traffic from the Resolver is forwarded through this VPC.

To prevent service interruptions, you cannot change this value after you create the outbound endpoint
parameters.help_zh:
出站专有网络ID（VPC ID），解析器所有出站的DNS查询流量都将经由此VPC进行流量转发。

为了避免误操作造成线上流量中断，创建出站终端节点之后，无法更改此值
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the security group. The rules in the security group are applied to the outbound VPC.

To prevent service interruptions, you cannot change this value after you create the outbound endpoint
parameters.help_zh:
安全组ID，安全组里面的规则将应用于出站VPC。

为了避免误操作造成线上流量中断，创建出站终端节点之后，无法更改此值
parameters.name: security_group_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the zone where the vSwitch resides
fields.name: az_id

fields.help_en: The IPv4 CIDR block of the vSwitch
fields.help_zh: 子网掩码，交换机的IPv4网段
fields.name: cidr_block

fields.help_en: The IP address. The IP address must be within the specified CIDR block. If you leave this parameter empty, the system automatically assigns an IP address
fields.help_zh: 子网掩码参数范围内的IP地址（留空则系统自动分配）
fields.name: ip

parameters.help_en:
The list of source IP addresses for outbound traffic. You must add at least two IP addresses. You can add up to six IP addresses.

To ensure high availability (HA), add at least two source IP addresses for the outbound endpoint. We recommend that you allocate these IP addresses in different zones. You can add a maximum of six source IP addresses
parameters.help_zh:
出站流量源IP地址列表（至少添加2个，最多可添加6个）。

为了保证高可用，出站终端节点要求至少添加2个出站源IP地址，而且建议这2个IP地址分配在不同的可用区，出站终端节点允许添加的出站源IP地址最多为6个
parameters.name: ip_config

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.

en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh：中文。

en：英文。

默认值：en
parameters.name: lang
